name: KMS Records
ownershipStory: Saunderson founded KMS in 1987 after watching Atkins and May run Metroplex and Transmat, initially to release his own and Inner City's material. The label later signed and developed artists including MK and Chez Damier.
hook: The third Belleville Three label, started once Saunderson saw his friends already running their own.
blurb: Kevin Saunderson founded KMS in 1987, following Juan Atkins and Derrick May, which completed the pattern of each of the Belleville Three owning his own label. KMS first pressed Inner City's "Big Fun" before it went on to sell widely through a licensing deal with 10 Records, part of the major label Virgin. That deal makes KMS the small but real crack in Detroit techno's otherwise consistent story of owning its own work.
